# codigate_workspace (Data Source)

The workspace the API token belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "codigate_workspace" "this" {}

output "app_domain" {
  value = data.codigate_workspace.this.app_domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `app_domain` (String) Domain for <app>.<slug> hostnames, for example acme.codigate.app.
- `id` (String) Workspace id (ws_...).
- `name` (String) Workspace name.
- `plan` (String) Current plan.
- `slug` (String) Workspace slug.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the workspace is suspended.
